inputs.checklistItemText: Trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted equipment are not identified as utility-compatible species per ECM Appendix F, or trees within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductors are not utility-compatible
inputs.question: Looking at Sheet 31 (Landscape Plan), are there any trees planted within 10 feet of any of the transformer pad locations shown on Sheet 21? If trees are present, are they labeled with species names?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing a progressive presence and labeling check (are trees present within 10 feet, and are they labeled with species?) rather than measuring clearance distances. The measurement of actual distances between trees and pads will come later if trees are found; this question is about identifying and reading labels on existing features.
